verses.text: O God, thou art my God; earnestly will I seek thee: My soul thirsteth for thee, my flesh longeth for thee, In a dry and weary land, where no water is.

segments.text: O God, thou art my God; earnestly will I seek thee:
My soul thirsteth for thee, my flesh longeth for thee,
In a dry and weary land, where no water is.

verses.text: So have I looked upon thee in the sanctuary, To see thy power and thy glory.

segments.text: So have I looked upon thee in the sanctuary,
To see thy power and thy glory.

verses.text: Because thy lovingkindness is better than life, My lips shall praise thee.

segments.text: Because thy lovingkindness is better than life,
My lips shall praise thee.

verses.text: So will I bless thee while I live: I will lift up my hands in thy name.

segments.text: So will I bless thee while I live:
I will lift up my hands in thy name.

verses.text: My soul shall be satisfied as with marrow and fatness; And my mouth shall praise thee with joyful lips;

segments.text: My soul shall be satisfied as with marrow and fatness;
And my mouth shall praise thee with joyful lips;

verses.text: When I remember thee upon my bed, And meditate on thee in the night-watches.

segments.text: When I remember thee upon my bed,
And
meditate on thee in the night-watches.

verses.text: For thou hast been my help, And in the shadow of thy wings will I rejoice.

segments.text: For thou hast been my help,
And in the shadow of thy wings will I rejoice.

verses.text: My soul followeth hard after thee: Thy right hand upholdeth me.

segments.text: My soul followeth hard after thee:
Thy right hand upholdeth me.

verses.text: But those that seek my soul, to destroy it, Shall go into the lower parts of the earth.

segments.text: But those that seek my soul, to destroy it,
Shall go into the lower parts of the earth.

verses.text: They shall be given over to the power of the sword: They shall be a portion for foxes.

segments.text: They shall be given over to the power of the sword:
They shall be a portion for foxes.

verses.text: But the king shall rejoice in God: Every one that sweareth by him shall glory; For the mouth of them that speak lies shall be stopped.

segments.text: But the king shall rejoice in God:
Every one that sweareth by him shall glory;
For the mouth of them that speak lies shall be stopped.

headings.text: A Psalm of David, when he was in the wilderness of Judah.
